question: Who took oath as the 49th Chief Justice of India in August 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is**__ Uday Umesh Lalit.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Justice Uday U Lalit** is set to take over as the 49th Chief Justice of India (CJI) on August 27, 2022, with the incumbent, NV Ramana recommending the former as his successor.
 
• Lalit will have a short tenure of** fewer than three months.**
